name: Owl
source:
He has a calm personality, but he has one or two quirks in his mind that he doesn't show. The cat on his shoulder is a different kind of demon...

Characteristics: Depending on the scent you have, he can seduce his opponent or cause them to die. 

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100430205322/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/sweet_oul.htm]official website[/url]]
